patch.summary: Is Streak worth it? Gmail-native CRM for pipelines, shared inbox context, mail merge, and lightweight sales collaboration inside Google Workspace.. Strong when Gmail-centric SMB sales and founder teams. Weak when CRM experience is tightly coupled to Gmail/Google Workspace — poor fit for Outlook-first teams..

blocks.body: Streak earns a yes only when researched fit beats researched limits — not when the brand is familiar.

sections.heading: Streak ROI gate for evaluators
sections.body:
Evaluator thesis: Worth the seat spend if contact management + lead management are weekly must-haves. Counter-signal: Not worth it if CRM experience is tightly coupled to Gmail/Google Workspace — poor fit for Outlook-first teams. collide with your constraints.

Capability hinge for this product: contact management; lead management; pipeline management; deal management.

Integrations in research: Gmail, Google Drive.

Paid tiers that usually matter in evaluation: Pro, Pro+, Enterprise.

sections.heading: Who Streak is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Teams that want CRM pipelines and deal context without leaving Gmail..

Avoid if: Outlook-first teams or buyers needing marketing automation / broader CRM ecosystems should compare Capsule, Pipedrive, or Keap..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with Capsule on the same job-to-be-done.

sections.heading: Streak price/value and next evaluation step
sections.body:
Prove one real workflow on the documented free/trial path before arguing for Pro.

Tradeoff to accept consciously: Inbox convenience vs platform lock-in to Gmail.

Next step: run contact management end-to-end, then decide.
